name: electerm-ai-auth-widget-example
description: An electerm widget that signs in to a ChatGPT or SuperGrok subscription and exposes it as a local OpenAI Responses endpoint.
author: ZHAO Xudong

electerm.name: AI subscription proxy
electerm.description: Sign in to a ChatGPT or SuperGrok subscription, then point electerm's AI config at the local proxy it runs.
electerm.author: ZHAO Xudong

configs.name: provider
configs.label: Provider
configs.description: Which subscription the proxy forwards to. One proxy serves one provider.

configs.name: port
configs.label: Local port
configs.description: The proxy listens on 127.0.0.1 at this port. Change it only if 8788 is taken; the URL in electerm's AI config has to match.

configs.name: autoRun
configs.label: Start with electerm
configs.description: Start this widget when electerm starts, so the AI panel keeps working without opening the widget list first.
